segments.sn23.22:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn23.22:1.5: “Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo, vedanā nirodhadhammo, saññā nirodhadhammo, saṅkhārā nirodhadhammo, viññāṇaṃ nirodhadhammo.
segments.sn23.22:1.6: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
segments.sn23.22:2.1: Māro ca māradhammo ca, aniccena apare duve;
segments.sn23.22:2.3: Dukkhena ca duve vuttā, anattena [anattehi (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] tatheva ca;
